About these terms

These terms apply to OCR Scanner – PDF & Text, the Android application with on-device recognition and optional Datalab cloud OCR, and its companion product website. The app is provided by its independent publisher. Contact: chennoufo11@gmail.com.

By using the app or website, you agree to use them under these terms. If you do not agree, you should stop using them. Store, device, account and third-party services may have additional terms. Nothing here limits rights that applicable consumer law does not allow us to limit.

Using the app

You may use the app to capture, import, process, organize and export documents you own or have permission to use. You are responsible for having any required consent, permissions and rights in the files you select.

Do not use the app or website for unlawful activity, to infringe another person’s rights, or to interfere with the website’s operation. Keep access to your device secure and use your device’s settings to control camera and file permissions.

Your documents and content

You retain your rights in documents, photos and recognized text. Using the app does not transfer ownership of them to the publisher. On-device recognition does not upload documents to an OCR server. If you choose Datalab and confirm the upload, you authorize the prepared pages to be sent to the publisher’s Cloudflare server and Datalab for recognition and the handling explained in the Privacy Policy.

You choose where to share and export content. Copies sent to other applications or saved outside this app are governed by those destinations and remain your responsibility. Keep your own copies of important documents.

Recognition and feature limits

OCR can make mistakes, including omitted words, characters, numbers and formatting. Review and correct recognized text before relying on it, especially for important records or decisions. Results vary with language, image quality, handwriting and layout.

The on-device engine supports English, French, Arabic, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese, Turkish, Russian, Hindi, Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean, with simple formatted, text and Markdown views. It does not reconstruct complex tables or embedded images. Datalab cloud OCR detects document languages automatically and can return richer formatting and extracted content when supported by the provider. A Tables or Images view may be empty if nothing is extracted. A failed cloud request does not silently switch to another engine.

The app exports TXT, Markdown and HTML; it does not export PDF or searchable PDF. Cropping is manual, and the app does not promise automatic document edge detection. The OCR engine can be changed only before recognition starts.

Free and optional Pro

Free supports up to 3 pages per document, all on-device OCR languages and editing tools, TXT export, copy, share, history and favorites. Optional Pro supports up to 25 pages per document with on-device recognition or 10 with Datalab cloud OCR, plus Markdown/HTML file exports. Cloud server usage, concurrency and availability limits also apply to Free and Pro; Pro does not promise unlimited cloud processing or bypass server quotas.

Confirmed Pro access suppresses ads. Version 1.4.0 ships with test and commercial advertising disabled; a later authorized configuration may change the mode. Required privacy choices and Pro ad suppression apply in either mode. Existing documents remain readable when upgrading.

Pro is a one-time purchase for this app edition, not a recurring subscription. Galaxy Store displays the applicable local price and any taxes before you confirm payment. The purchase must be available in your region and is subject to Samsung’s payment and refund rules and mandatory consumer rights. Future separate products are not promised as part of Pro.

Buy or restore using the same Samsung account through Galaxy Store. Confirmed access is cached for offline use and updated when ownership is checked. A refunded or unavailable entitlement may be removed. Clearing app data removes the local cache; restore purchases to recover eligible ownership. If confirmation is interrupted, restore before trying another purchase.

Optional cloud service

Datalab cloud recognition requires internet, Google sign-in and confirmation of each document upload. Cloud access is available only after server processing and sign-in have been configured and may be unavailable because of service limits, connectivity or provider setup. Selecting the cloud engine does not guarantee that it is currently available.

Our server copies expire 24 hours after job creation, with scheduled physical cleanup that may be delayed or retried. Minimal records for quotas and duplicate-request protection are scheduled for removal 48 hours after content expiry. Datalab retention follows its own policy and applicable service agreement. Local deletion or sign-out does not guarantee immediate deletion of cloud or provider copies.

Only upload content you are permitted to send to the processing services. Do not interfere with authentication, attempt to access another user’s jobs or bypass service limits. Provider service terms and applicable data-processing arrangements also govern cloud processing; see Datalab’s service agreement.

Privacy and permissions

The bundled Privacy Policy explains local processing, optional cloud uploads, Google sign-in, server expiry, provider retention, Samsung purchases, Google ads and privacy choices, online configuration, support and website hosting. The public policy is available at this website.

On-device OCR needs no account or internet access. Datalab OCR uses internet and sign-in. Purchases, ads, privacy messages and configuration use online services with their own terms and privacy practices. Settings provides Ad privacy choices when required. Files selected or shared through third-party providers are subject to those providers’ own practices.

Availability and updates

Features, compatibility and distribution may change through updates. The current Galaxy release is designed for ARM64 Android devices running Android 8.0 or later. The relevant store listing determines supported devices and availability.

The Galaxy Store release is being prepared. Promotional website images do not guarantee that a listing is already live. A verified download link will be provided once available.

We do not guarantee uninterrupted website access, compatibility with every device or recovery of deleted app data. The app disables Android backup of its private data, so retain any files you need separately.
